# Hostyler

> Hostyler Group is a senior web, app, and AI development team for founders who need to ship real products — fixed timelines, full code ownership, and no junior handoffs.

We build marketing sites, SaaS products, e-commerce platforms, and AI automations for startups and scale-ups. Public marketing content is listed below; client portal, admin, and payment flows are excluded.

## Services

- [Web development](https://hostyler.com/services/web-development): Next.js marketing sites, SaaS dashboards, e-commerce, and platform rebuilds.
- [App development](https://hostyler.com/services/app-development): iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile apps with production-ready backends.
- [AI automation](https://hostyler.com/services/ai-automation): Custom AI workflows, agents, and integrations for business operations.
